Compile a model

Source: R/pmx_ode_model.R
pmx_ode_model.Rd

Reads a model written in the subset of rxode2's model language that zupmxode runs (design §6.1), and compiles it to native code through MIR, with no C compiler. The model is R syntax, read by R's parser: assignments with <- or =, d/dt(x) for a derivative, x(0) for an initial amount, alag(x), f(x), rate(x) and dur(x) for dosing into x, if/else, comparison and logical operators, linCmt(), and the functions exp, log, sqrt, abs, floor, ceiling, sin, cos, tan, gamma, lgamma, logit, expit, probit, probitInv, min and max. Every name the model reads but never assigns is a parameter, given at solve time.

Usage

pmx_ode_model(model, tier = "auto")

Arguments

model

The model: a braced expression, a function whose body is the model, or its text.

tier

The tier to run on: "auto", "native" or "interp"; see pmx_ode_tier().

Value

A model of class pmx_ode_model.

Errors

pmx_ode_error_compile for a construct outside the subset, naming it, its position, and the nearest supported alternative.

Examples

m <- pmx_ode_model({
  ka <- exp(tka); cl <- exp(tcl); v <- exp(tv)
  d/dt(depot) <- -ka * depot
  d/dt(central) <- ka * depot - cl / v * central
  cp <- central / v
})
m
#> <pmx_ode_model> linear, 2 compartments on the native tier
#>   compartments: depot, central
#>   parameters:   tka, tcl, tv
#>   outputs:      ka, cl, v, cp
